newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bonn to set Bubill tender Jan 14 - Bundesbank.
newsitem.headline: Bonn to set Bubill tender Jan 14 - Bundesbank.

text.p: The German government will set a tender for six-month German Treasury discount paper, or "Bubills," on January 14, the Bundesbank as issuing agent said on Tuesday.
Bids from credit institutions will be accepted until 1000 GMT on January 15 and the pay date is scheduled for January 17, the central bank said.
The Bonn government's issuing calendar for the first quarter of 1997 says that up to 11 billion marks of Bubills will be issued.
